physicalNotes: Install U1 with pin 1 at F10 and program the internal 8 MHz clock without division. A0 is PC0 and D9 is PB1/OC1A.
The trimmer wiper feeds A0. Q1 uses source, gate and drain in the lead order specified for the lead-formed package. Use insulated pigtails from Q1 to the BB400. R2 holds the gate low during reset.

pcbFabrication.fabricationNotes: J1 supplies 5 V and return. RV1 drives A0 and D9 drives the low-side MOSFET. Program U1 for the internal 8 MHz oscillator without division.
